note: SOURCE SCANS ARE NOT IN GIT. This pins the exact bytes the committed library was normalized from, so a future build can re-pull byte-identical sources. Cache location is gitignored (tools/asset_cache/).  TEXTURE SETS are the exception to 'not in git': the tileable PBR maps ARE committed under tex/, and the entry below pins the byte-identical PolyHaven original each shipped file was copied from, at the per-map resolution the manifest records.  Two masonry candidates (old_stone_wall_02, stone_wall_04) keep their pins although their files were dropped after the crop gate rejected them (see manifest `dropped`): a pin costs a few hundred bytes and is the whole cost of making that comparison re-runnable.  The village-surface round (roof_thatch, roof_slate, roof_tile, paving_cobble, timber_board) adds five shipped sets pinned map-for-map, and twenty-four MEASURED-ONLY pins for the candidates it measured and dropped - those carry the 2k diffuse alone, because that is the only file the albedo ruler read and the only bytes that were ever fetched.

thatch_roof_angled.note: MEASURED-ONLY pin. Only the 2k diffuse was ever pulled for this candidate - it is the map the albedo ruler reads and the only bytes this round can honestly pin. Re-running the comparison is one download; shipping the set is four.
